description: This file contains unit tests for the WebAudio Eos (End of Stream) functionality, specifically testing the behavior of setting EOS on a GstAppSrc element within the WebAudio context. It uses Google Test framework and mocks for GstWrapper.

classes.name: WebAudioEosTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for testing WebAudio Eos functionality using Google Test framework.

methods.name: shouldSetEos
methods.description: Test case verifying that the Eos task successfully calls gstAppSrcEndOfStream and completes without error.

methods.name: shouldFailToSetEos
methods.description: Test case verifying that the Eos task correctly handles a failure response from gstAppSrcEndOfStream.
